name: PumpkinMC
description: Pumpkin is a high-performance Minecraft server software written entirely in Rust, supporting both Java and Bedrock Edition clients. NOTE: Pumpkin is experimental software under active development and is not yet feature-complete. It is not recommended for production worlds. Always keep backups of your world data. The "latest" image tracks the most recent release build, so compatibility may change often. Configuration files (config.toml, etc) are generated in the data folder on first launch and can be edited there. TIP: If Crafty Controller or another Minecraft server is already using port 25565, change the host port here to something free (e.g. 30000).

paths.name: Server Data
paths.description: Pumpkin server data, world files, and config.

ports.name: Java Minecraft Port
ports.description: Java Edition server port. Change the host port if Crafty or another server already uses 25565.

ports.name: Bedrock Port
ports.description: Optional Bedrock Edition UDP port, used only if Bedrock support is enabled in config.toml.

ports.name: RCON Port
ports.description: Optional RCON admin port. Disabled by default; enable it and set a strong password under [networking.rcon] in config.toml before exposing it.

variables.name: RUST_LOG
variables.description: Logging verbosity. Options: error, warn, info, debug, trace.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for log timestamps, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.
